toegepas.voor: Die Grondwet sê die hof het elf regters.
toegepas.na: Die Grondwet sê die Konstitusionele Hof het elf regters.
toegepas.rede_vinder: A new block opens with 'die hof', and the previous block ended on other courts' rulings, so the court is named to make the reference unambiguous.
toegepas.fout: A new block opens with 'die hof' right after a block that also spoke of 'n ander hoër hof', so the referent is unclear and a reader can take it as any court.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Naming the court the block is about removes the ambiguity, adds no new fact, and uses the protected form of the name.

toegepas.blok: Die howe hou wag oor die Grondwet
toegepas.voor: mag beslis of 'n wet by die Grondwet hou, nie 'n landdroshof nie.
toegepas.na: mag beslis of 'n wet by die Grondwet hou. 'n Landdroshof mag dit nie doen nie.
toegepas.rede_vinder: The contrast tacked onto the end of a long sentence after the object clause is hard for a Grade 6 reader to follow; a short sentence of its own says the same more clearly.
toegepas.fout: The contrast 'nie 'n landdroshof nie' is tacked onto a long sentence right after 'hou,', so a reader can briefly misread it as negating 'hou'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: A short sentence of its own says the same thing (a magistrate's court may not decide this) more clearly for a Grade 6 reader, and the plural 'daardie howe' in the next sentence still points to the higher courts.

laat_vaar.voor: Nie een regter beslis dit alleen nie.
laat_vaar.na: Geen regter beslis dit alleen nie.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Geen regter' is the more natural Afrikaans form for this general statement; 'nie een regter' sounds slightly translated.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Nie een regter ... nie' is natural, emphatic Afrikaans and not a translation, so 'Geen regter' is only a lateral swap.

vlae.teks: Die hoogste wet, en die howe wat daaroor wag hou
vlae.rede: The title has a comma before 'en' joining two noun phrases, not two sentences, which AWS 2017 does not call for; titles cannot be changed by this step, so it is flagged for the writer.
